titolo: Everstone Studio integrates NVIDIA DLSS 5 into Where Winds Meet
descr: Everstone adds neural rendering via DLSS 5, enhancing lighting and materials while offering player controls.
paragrafi: Everstone Studio announced that its upcoming title Where Winds Meet will use NVIDIA DLSS 5.
The studio leveraged its existing NVIDIA Streamline integration to adopt DLSS 5, using model selection and structural and tonal strength controls.
Artists reported deeper lighting, softened harsh highlights, richer shadows and more detailed wood and roof‑tile textures.
Internal testing showed that DLSS 5 adds performance overhead, so Everstone plans to let players enable or disable the feature and choose the model that fits their aesthetic.
The team emphasized balancing visual gains with the game’s original art direction and character recognizability.
perche: For creators, early integration with Streamline can smooth adoption. For gamers, optional controls let them weigh image quality against performance, a useful model for future titles using AI‑enhanced graphics.
